name: onewave-toolkit
description: A coding, marketing and sales team in one plugin: 12 specialist agents, 16 skills, 4 team commands, 10 Claude Code mods and a secret guard hook that stops Claude from leaking API keys.

burnMeter.title: Burn Meter mod
burnMeter.description: Live session cost above the prompt with plan limits and a /burn pane

launchCodes.title: Launch Codes mod
launchCodes.description: Hold dangerous Bash commands (rm -rf, force push, DROP, prod deploys) until you type a one-time code

sessionWrapped.title: Session Wrapped mod
sessionWrapped.description: /wrapped: an animated session recap and a shareable PNG card (needs python3)

bossFight.title: Boss Fight mod
bossFight.description: Failing tests spawn a pixel boss; fixing tests lands hits

codePet.title: Code Pet mod
codePet.description: A pixel pet that reacts to what Claude does

agentNarrator.title: Agent Narrator mod
agentNarrator.description: /narrate: every agent step in plain English with a time-saved counter

agentRace.title: Agent Race mod
agentRace.description: /race: race several sessions on one task on a live scoreboard

innerMonologue.title: Inner Monologue mod
innerMonologue.description: A pane of Claude's dry inner thoughts. Calls a small model while the pane is open

sportscaster.title: Sportscaster mod
sportscaster.description: Spoken play-by-play of the session with crowd sounds. Calls a small model and plays audio

inboxAlerts.title: Inbox Alerts mod
inboxAlerts.description: Gmail, Slack and Calendar alerts through your claude.ai connectors. Reads your inbox

email.title: Your email (Inbox Alerts)
email.description: Your Gmail address, so your own sent mail is not an alert

slackUserId.title: Your Slack member ID (Inbox Alerts)
slackUserId.description: Your Slack member ID (U...), used to find mentions and DMs
